letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your smile lights up my day like the desert sun, and your laughter is the sweetest melody in the bustling streets we call home. I cherish our late‑night chai talks, our spontaneous dance in the kitchen, and the way you call me “cutie” with that mischievous sparkle in your eyes. Forever yours, today and always.
poem:
In desert sands or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the rhythm in my vein.  
With you, each moment feels brand new,  
My heart beats only for you.
